{{Top|leg}}
The '''Kuat Minedromes''' were massive ore mining and shipping complexes located in a high-altitude region of cliffs and mesas on [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]]. During the [[Battle of Kuat (Galactic War)|Battle of Kuat]] the minedromes were targeted by Sith Empire forces looking to interrupt production at the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]].
